quarterly_data.quarter: Nan Ya PCB IR presentation: MOPS 804620260826E001 (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Nan Ya PCB 2026H1 operation briefing: mass production of 1.6T switch substrates drove 2Q26 revenue 21.5% above 1Q26, and mass production of IC substrates for 1.6T switches optimized the product mix, lifting 2Q26 operating profit by NTD 1,547.2 Mn from 1Q26.
quarterly_data.figure: 2Q26 revenue +21.5% QoQ; operating profit +NTD 1,547.2 Mn QoQ

quarterly_data.quarter: Nan Ya PCB IR presentation: MOPS 804620260826E001 (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Nan Ya PCB 1H26 consolidated revenue NTD 24.8 Billion, 37.2% above 1H25 on sustained data-center demand and increased high-end IC substrate sales; 1H26 operating profit rose NTD 3,852.4 Mn from 1H25 on rising demand for high-end servers, switches and memory. Component shortages constrained PC and consumer-electronics growth, the high-end switch upgrade kept the networking revenue contribution elevated, and the AI/HPC and automotive contributions were on par with 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: 1H26 revenue NTD 24.8 Billion (+37.2% YoY); operating profit +NTD 3,852.4 Mn YoY

quarterly_data.quarter: Nan Ya PCB IR presentation: MOPS 804620260826E001 (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Future product development (company, August 2026): with CSPs raising data-center capex, Nan Ya PCB is working with customers on large-area, high-layer-count ABF substrates for next-generation AI server ASICs, CPUs and high-speed switch chips, and, citing inference-AI growth, will mass-produce substrates for high-end AI PCs; in BT substrates it is partnering with customers on substrates for next-gen servers and power IC chips; in conventional PCB it will develop and mass-produce server mainboards, server secondary boards and high-layer switch boards.
